get.description: One part of the project's evidence: up to 100,000 rows, oldest first. When more rows remain, the response carries the X-ChatGuard-Next-Cursor header; pass its value as `after` to get the next part. No header means this was the last part.

AuthorExport.description:
Everything a project stores for one author id, oldest first: the answer to a player's access or portability request.
thread_lines are the player's lines kept as thread context in other players' evidence; feedback holds the feedback
(with notes) on the player's verdicts. Each list covers at most 100,000 stored rows; truncated is true when one of
them stopped there and newer rows were left out.

AuthorThreadLine.description: One line of the player's, kept as thread context in another player's evidence row (evidence_id, ts).

flag.description: p at or above this value recommends at least Flag.

hide.description: p at or above this value recommends at least Hide.

block.description: p at or above this value recommends Block.

CategoryThresholds.description: Per-category probability thresholds. A null level means that level is not used for the category.

CreateKeyResponse.description: The secret is returned exactly once.

CreateOrgRequest.description: TurnstileToken: the Cloudflare Turnstile widget's token, required while the check is on (GET /api/turnstile).

EvidenceErasureResponse.description:
What an erasure changed: the player's evidence rows deleted; their verdict rows stripped of author id, message hash
and request id; other evidence rows whose stored thread context lost the player's lines; feedback notes cleared on
the player's verdicts.

request_id.description: Client-generated id; the same id within 10 minutes replays the same response.

OrgSummary.description: suspended_at and suspended_reason are set while the organization is suspended; the dashboard shows the reason to its members.

rules.description: When present, replaces the project's saved allow/block/context rules (send the full list).

ProjectTestRequest.description: Body of POST /api/projects/{projectId}/test. Draft values replace the saved ones for this call only.

QuotaView.description: Rolling 30-UTC-day usage of the organization in model verdicts: block-rule hits, degraded answers, test keys and replays are not counted.

score_weight.description: Share of the severity taken from the model Score (0..1); the rest comes from verdicts.

SeverityWeights.description: Weights for the severity score. A project may override the defaults in its settings.

severity_block.description: Severity (0..3) at or above which the action is Block.

flag_below_score_confidence.description: When the model's Score confidence is below this, the action is at least Flag.

Thresholds.description: Project-editable action thresholds. The defaults: block if threat.p ≥ 0.85 or severity ≥ 2.5; hide if insult/hate/sexual ≥ 0.80; flag if any category ≥ 0.55 or the Score confidence is below 0.5; otherwise allow.

clear_severity_weights.description: Set to true to remove the project severity-weight override.

UsageDayDto.description: Model verdicts on one UTC day: the metered counter, the same source as the quota and billing.

VerdictRow.description: message_hash and author_opaque_id are null once the author was erased.

ApiKey.description: A key of the project, sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>. cg_live_ keys are for servers, cg_pub_ keys ship in game clients (POST /v1/moderate and GET /v1/quota only, author.id required), cg_test_ keys are for the Editor and development builds.

DashboardToken.description: The dashboard's short-lived access token, from POST /api/auth/refresh.
